notes: The released package (scrolls-inkfilter on its branch) installed in kit's Python or on PATH; numpy and tifffile for TIFF stacks. Fixed filters, no weights. AutoPipeline's ink stage can use it as backend reg:inkfilter.

volume.label: the active segment's surface volume (layers/ or a zarr), shape Z, H, W

crop.label: a box on the segment's canvas (from VC3D's focus region or --crop)

record.label: the run's record: recipe, shape, crop

compute.scales_with: surface-volume voxels; two float32 maps of the canvas (a crop is far smaller); real-data time not measured yet

vc3d.label: Inkfilter map of the active segment, with its reverse-depth control

facts.title: inkfilter
facts.tagline: fixed image filters for surface volumes
facts.network: None for filtering, the synthetic demo or saved-score aggregation. Installing dependencies contacts the configured Python package index
